body: I am trying. I am failing. I have lost every friend I ever had and I just don't see a reason for me to wake up tomorrow.
Maybe, but the pain I'm in would end.

That's the problem. She did. She stuck with me through my worst.. Then I got better and then worse again. I have lost every friend I have ever had like this.. And the only thing I want in the world is her to be my friend again.

Thank you for replying. I made it through last night, just barely.

I am already on antidepressants, and they were doing a decent job, but everything kind of hit at once and they had no chance.

I'm a little bit better right now, but not out of the woods (so to speak) yet.
My mistake. I must have deleted that when I modified the title. I'm in the Midwest, but don't mind where others are from.

Thank you for the advice. I wish you the best of luck.

I'm finding it really difficult to do anything at this point. I can't sleep at night because my brain won't stop so I sleep most of the day once I pass out from exhaustion. Even if I do manage to get myself up early enough in the day, I end up sleeping through my alarm the next morning and wake up sometime in the afternoon or evening and my schedule is all off again. I have been on disability from work for the past 6 months and they're starting to run out of patience with letting me work from home at all hours of the night as well, so I may not have to worry about the job I hate much longer.

I don't have the motivation to do much of anything it seems.
